name: search_mail
summary: Search Mail.app's indexed content via Spotlight (subjects, senders, body text). See docs/issues/note-applescript-mail-search-deferred.md for known precision gaps (very new mail, recently-migrated archives, Junk/Spam, account-exact scoping).

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text search term (subject, sender, or body content).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20, maximum 50).

name: send_mail
summary: Compose and SEND a real email via Mail.app. Irreversible: there is no undo for a sent email.

params.name: attachments
params.description: Absolute or ~-relative path(s) of file(s) to attach; each must already exist. Supply the exact path — if you only know a description of where the file is (e.g. "in Downloads"), use the filesystem tool (ls/find) to locate it first, then pass the resolved path here.
